ValidationRule.description: Excluded stage is only available from Draft stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Excluded") && ( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Closed") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Solicitation") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Committed") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Follow Up") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Cancelled") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Withdrawn") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Blood Drive Opportunity may only be moved to the Excluded Stage from the Discovery Stage.
